Class IntellijHintInfo

java.lang.Object
uno.anahata.asi.ide.tools.hints.HintInfo
uno.anahata.asi.intellij.tools.java.IntellijHintInfo
public class IntellijHintInfo extends HintInfo
IntelliJ-specific diagnostic DTO extending HintInfo with available quick-fix actions.

Captures intention action names associated with an IntelliJ HighlightInfo and formats them directly into the Markdown representation, allowing AI models to execute single-shot fixes via IntellijHints.applyHint(String, int, String).

anahata

  • Constructor Details

    • IntellijHintInfo

      public IntellijHintInfo(String filePath, String description, String severity, int line, int column, String id, List<String> quickFixes)
      Constructs a new IntellijHintInfo with full diagnostic metadata and quick-fix actions.
      Parameters:
      filePath - The absolute canonical path of the file containing the hint.
      description - A human-readable description or diagnostic message.
      severity - The localized severity string reported by IntelliJ.
      line - The 1-based line number where the diagnostic starts.
      column - The 1-based column number where the diagnostic starts.
      id - The inspection tool ID or short name.
      quickFixes - The list of available quick-fix action names.
